01 / Profile

Hardware curiosity.
Systems thinking.

Bringing together enterprise systems experience and a growing foundation in digital VLSI design.

About me

I work across Linux-based enterprise systems and digital hardware learning. At Tech Mahindra, my role involved shell scripting and operational automation, system-level debugging, log investigation, fault analysis, process and memory monitoring, and API-driven integration workflows.

Alongside work, I am pursuing an M.Tech in VLSI Design with a focus on Digital VLSI and FPGA/ASIC. My project work includes synchronous dual-port RAM RTL, FIFO status-flag logic, and an embedded gas-sensor detector.

I enjoy understanding how systems behave, diagnosing what goes wrong, and validating designs with structured tests.

03 / Selected work

Projects that help students grow.

My student-focused initiatives: practical learning websites, GATE preparation, digital electronics, Verilog labs, and communities that help learners move toward IT and VLSI careers.

01 / MEMORY RTL
RTL design · Oct 2025

Synchronous Dual-Port RAM

Created synthesizable Verilog RTL for a synchronous dual-port memory architecture, supporting parallel read/write access with reset control. Checked functional behavior using a Verilog testbench and ModelSim.

VerilogRTLModelSimTestbench
02 / FIFO DESIGN
Digital design · Nov 2025

FIFO Architecture with Status Flags

Built a pointer-driven FIFO for sequential data flow, with full and empty indicators to support safe transfers. Evaluated overflow and underflow scenarios through testbench-driven checks.

VerilogPointersFull / EmptyVerification
03 / EMBEDDED SYSTEMS
B.Tech final project

Gas Sensor Detector

Developed an embedded gas-monitoring solution using Arduino Uno and sensing modules. Validated functional behavior in TinkerCAD and used Embedded C logic to support real-time alerts.

Arduino UnoEmbedded CTinkerCADSensors

Helping students move from learning to opportunity.
